effect.ruby-sapphire: If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself. Does not redirect Hidden Power.
effect.emerald: If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself. Does not redirect Hidden Power. Overworld: Increases the frequency of Match Call calls on the overworld if any party Pokémon has this ability.
